caption:
❗️A farmer trusted AI for farming advice after it had helped him for about a year. Then it helped wipe out 25 acres of his crops.

The 67-year-old farmer in China used an AI chatbot to get advice about weeds and pests, he followed the advice to mix several chemicals and spray them across his sesame field.

By the next morning, about 25 acres of his sesame crop had been destroyed.
